holdout_dti.evaluator: gems58w.metric/v1 (exact triangular kernel, R=3 px, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8)

ci.note: min-max over the four spatial blocks. A bootstrap over 4 blocks resamples repeated physical blocks as independent, so no bootstrap CI is reported (the defect the previous instrument had).

holdout_dti.note: HOLDOUT-DTI of the exact delivered bytes on the buffered hide-and-recover holdout. The holdout's withheld truth is catalogue, so this measures catalogue recovery, not the organizer's new-fault truth; it is not a leaderboard forecast.

credit_calibration.interpretation: every stratum's expected credit is below the marginal-inclusion bar alpha*DTI0 = 0.0827 at the organizer-confirmed leader score, i.e. this surface cannot support a live score of that order; the gap is coverage, not geometry

uniqueness_local.definitions: forward_overlap = fraction of MY dots within 3 px of the witness's dots (gems57.uniqueness.dot_overlap); reverse_overlap = fraction of the witness's dots within 3 px of mine; E = fraction of the footprint within 3 px of the witness's dots; lift = (observed - E) / (1 - E).
